turns.patient_response: I'm just... really struggling with how my skin and the shape of my nose look. It feels like this horrible, obvious defect that everyone notices immediately, even though my friends keep telling me it looks completely normal. I just feel so anxious and ugly all the time because of it.

symptom_reasoning.S067: The patient describes a strong preoccupation with perceived defects in their skin and the shape of their nose, which they perceive as highly obvious despite reassurance from friends that they look completely normal.
